implementation: GridLayoutNode requires generated-valid fields, a safe integer column count from 1 through 12, a non-empty dense canonical children array, and a valid optional gap_token before layout-grid geometry is emitted.

The grid preserves the canonical column count without Math.max/clamping, emits bounded data-layout-columns and child indexes, and wraps each ordered child as one actual grid item; no omitted contribution is filtered into a placeholder or inferred locally.

Children render recursively through ProjectionLayoutRenderer with the supplied trusted registry, including nested grids whose binding is not in the default registry; order and optional gap metadata remain canonical projection data.

The existing recursive validation guard rejects duplicate node/contribution identities and shared child objects as one tree, so malformed or untrusted input cannot leave a valid prefix, vacant placeholder, border, heading, or reserved child geometry.

No local eligibility/layout resolver, Workstream authority resolver, stale watermark repair, capability inference, local layout store, resize control, or generated operation replacement was added. Canonical mutations remain owned by focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate.

negative_cases.ordered_children_and_nested_recursion: A valid two-column grid preserves the canonical columns, gap token, child indexes, and first/second contribution order. A nested grid renders recursively and its custom trusted binding proves the registry is propagated rather than replaced by the default registry.
negative_cases.empty_or_omitted_contribution: An empty child list or an omitted contribution ID rejects the complete grid before layout-grid, grid-child, layout-single, or contribution host output; no vacant cell or valid-prefix geometry remains.
negative_cases.foreign_keyed_contribution: A contribution stored under a key whose DTO contribution_id does not match the requested layout ID is rejected; the grid does not repair the map or infer a replacement.
negative_cases.unknown_renderer_or_semantic_binding: Unknown renderer bindings and non-allowlisted semantic bindings are rejected by the trusted registry before any grid wrapper is created; no generic or substitute panel is rendered.
negative_cases.missing_authority: Deleting a contribution AuthorityDescriptor causes trusted resolution to fail and leaves no grid geometry.
negative_cases.invalid_grid_shape: Zero, over-limit, fractional, string, and non-finite column values; empty or malformed gap tokens; sparse/non-index child arrays; unknown fields; unknown node kinds; duplicate node/contribution identities; and shared child objects fail closed as one tree.
negative_cases.foreign_scope_stale_revision_cursor_unav: Exact Workstream/Attachment scope, stale projection/layout/cursor watermarks, and unavailable operation/capability paths remain enforced by generated transport and MissionCanvasProjectionController/EventClient seams already exercised by the same runtime test. Grid rendering does not infer, repair, or replace those authority checks.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Core omission diagnostics and canonical layout determine the eligible contribution map. Desktop consumes that map and refuses any grid reference absent from it rather than creating a dead contribution or reserved geometry.
negative_cases.resize_mutation: The grid renderer emits no resize control or local mutation. DesktopMissionCanvasRuntime owns the generated layout mutation operation and supplies exact authority, expected projection/layout revisions, command, and idempotency fields to focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate.

acceptance: Grid does not create vacant cells for omitted contributions.
Omitted contribution IDs cannot leave DOM nodes, headings, borders, or gaps.
Unknown semantic or renderer binding fails closed; no substitute panel is rendered.
Resize mutations call focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate rather than changing canonical layout locally.
